terminals.name: core-service
terminals.description: core-service (Spring Boot / JPA + MongoDB) dev server on http://localhost:8081
terminals.command: cd core-service && SERVER_PORT=8081 SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL=jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/coredb SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME=core SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD=core SPRING_DATA_MONGODB_URI=mongodb://localhost:27017/coredb ./mvnw -ntp spring-boot:run

terminals.name: api-gateway
terminals.description: api-gateway (Spring Cloud Gateway + Redis) dev server on http://localhost:8080
terminals.command: cd api-gateway && SERVER_PORT=8080 SPRING_DATA_REDIS_HOST=localhost SPRING_DATA_REDIS_PORT=6379 ./mvnw -ntp spring-boot:run
